name: Millie & Finny
source:
Last year, Milliana embarrassed herself by forgetting to prepare an outfit for the annual witch costume party and went in her pajamas!

HER PAJAMAS!!!

But she'll get it right this time! Except, she forgot. AGAIN! Nothing a potion can't fix...right?

[From [url=https://otojang.itch.io/millie-and-finny]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
去年，米莉安娜居然忘了为一年一度的魔女变装派对准备礼服，直接穿着一身睡衣去赴宴，当场出尽了洋相！

穿着她的睡衣啊！！！

不过今年她绝对会把一切安排得妥妥当当！……只可惜，她又双叒叕给忘了！但没有什么难题是一瓶魔药搞不定的……对吧？

[摘自[url=https://otojang.itch.io/millie-and-finny]itch.io[/url]]
